reviewer: root technical operational peer, not eligible GitHub approval
scope: Read complete run.py, all16 data controls, exact input-contract and bound workflow. This is an operational review, not a substitute for native source/seam or Python plugin peers.

Workflow admits exact macOS14 ARM, Python3.12.10, source/venv, uv0.9.26 and Rust1.88.0 with frozen/locked dependencies. Exact source and driver commits/parents/changed-path rosters and every selected source/driver body are verified before and after.

Data controls fail on native capture loss, observer faults, overflow, restoration mismatch, duplicate/missing/mismatched call joins, failed original stop, mismatched outcome/selector/module, wrong rows and incomplete native/Python test rosters. Root read owner controls; no redundant local rerun.

Hosted gate requires16 unique passing data controls,27 unique collected/executed source controls, Rust formatting, then exact eight default and eight diagnostic-feature native controls with namespace/identity joins. The diagnostic runtime is built with locked dependencies, hash-bound before and after admitted observation, and explicitly not the original default artifact.

Original selector is offered once only after all gates. Original policy-push/hook/termination/stop budgets remain in unmodified source; wrapper60second outer bound does not replace original2/8/3second inner budgets. No added policy push or OS liveness query is introduced by this runner.

Original pytest result/exit are preserved. A complete diagnostic can retain an original failed test; the final workflow still returns its original failing status. Missing/incomplete/ambiguous capture cannot become a passed diagnostic.

Original call ordinals, roles, returns/raises, one stop with zero exit and exact single unskipped original JUnit case are joined. An earlier original failure may leave later calls unoffered. The gate does not pretend two successful hooks were executed.

Always-retained artifacts include original stdout/stderr/exit, binary identity, invocations, source/driver before-after and original observation. A subprocess timeout kills/reaps the direct child; full descendant cleanup is explicitly unproved. No nonreproduction-to-cause or uninstrumented latency inference is made.
remaining_before_launch: CI owner must retain the separate concrete Rust source/seam clearance, verify unused exact branch/ref and final tree/trigger binding. Existing authorization permits this unique isolated execution without further root approval. A source or semantic driver change needs its corresponding focused review.
